title: fix(plugin-grid, plugin-list): $select asks for a shown column's dependsOn siblings (objectui#13214)
body:
Fixes #13214
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A list's `$select` now asks for a shown column's declared `dependsOn` siblings. A faced column reads those siblings off the row it draws (`dependentValues={row}`): the `recipient-picker` face names a stored id by the row's `recipient_type`, and draws the stored text when the kind is absent. Neither projection builder asked for them, so the four Record Shares views that show `recipient_id` without `recipient_type` drew the raw user id.

One declaration-driven arm, in both hosts, beside the `referenceVia` type-half arm of objectui#13036 (PR #13042 put that arm inline in each host; there is no shared helper, so this follows the same shape):

- `ObjectGrid` `getSelectFields` (the fetch a standalone grid and a grouped grid that owns its fetch send): `dependsOnFields`, unioned into `extraFields`.
- `ListView` data-fetch projection: one loop over `cols` into `addSpeculative`.

Rules, per the dispatch rulings:

1. Every sibling the shown column's field names in `dependsOn` (read through `resolveDependsOnFields` from `@object-ui/core`, so the `{ field, param }` form contributes its `field`). No name mapped here; nothing is added to the views' columns.
2. Only real fields of the object: the same known-field gate the other arms take (`isProjectableField` in the grid, `addSpeculative` in the list), plus the same FLS gate. An unknown name is never sent.
3. A column authored `hidden: true` pulls nothing; a column the viewer may not read pulls nothing. The harvest stays a deduplicated union.

## Tests (at `9d6a4ef795`)

New pins:

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.dependsOnSelect-13214.test.tsx`: (a) `recipient_type` in `$select` with only `recipient_id` shown, and (b) end to end: a face registered under the `recipient-picker` key for this file, reading the kind off `dependentValues` against a stubbed directory, draws "Ada Lovelace", not `usr_1`. Controls: (c) a `hidden: true` column pulls nothing, (d) an undeclared `dependsOn` name is not sent, a denied sibling is not asked for, and a sibling that is also a column is sent once.
- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.dependsOnSelect-13214.test.tsx`: (a) for `ListView`'s own fetch, plus the same controls and a denied column pulling nothing. plugin-list does not depend on plugin-grid, so a stub grid stands in, as in the objectui#13036 file.

Ablation (each run through `ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restore; the restore was proven by blob hash equal to the HEAD blob and an empty `git diff HEAD`):

- Grid arm dropped from the `extraFields` union: the (a)+(b) case goes red (`Unable to find an element with the text: Ada Lovelace`), 1 failed and 4 passed. Restored blob `9d04784f1ca8` equals HEAD.
- List arm's `addSpeculative` loop replaced: the (a) case goes red, 1 failed and 5 passed. Restored blob `0333a4d59106` equals HEAD.
- Hidden filter removed in both hosts: both (c) controls go red, 2 failed and 9 passed. Both restored to the HEAD blobs.
- The (d) control was not ablated.

Local gates (every exit was recorded to a file):

- Closure build `pnpm --filter "@object-ui/plugin-grid^..." --filter "@object-ui/plugin-list^..." run build`: 0. `type-check` for plugin-grid and plugin-list: 0. Both new tests are in each `tsconfig.test.json`, checked with `--listFilesOnly`.
- vitest, under the shared lock, with `--maxWorkers=1`: the two new files gave 11 passed. Every test file in the two packages that names `$select`: plugin-grid 24 files, 202 passed; plugin-list 27 files, 436 passed.
- eslint on the four changed source and test files: 0 errors (warnings only, none on the added source lines). This is a narrowed run, not the package `eslint .`. Both packages' full directories (tests and lint) are left to CI.
- Pre-tsc battery, all 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, and `check:new-line-citations` (0 new).

## Acceptance notes

- `ListView`'s view-level `hiddenFields` (the toolbar's hide toggle) does not stop a column from pulling its siblings. The fetch effect does not re-run on that toggle, and the hidden column's own value is still fetched. So unhiding a column draws it whole without a refetch. Only a column entry authored `hidden: true` counts as hidden here, in both hosts.
- Changeset: `.changeset/13214-select-dependson.md`, a `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-list`. No export, prop or type member moves.
